header.title: Suppl. Mag. 86: magical spells to find a thief: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64337:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.1.10: Fragmentary rites for finding a thief. Lines 1, 20 and 21 keep only scattered letters. The verb in line 5 (ekbal-, 'put out' or 'cast out') is broken off. 'k*ete' (line 11) and 'bre-' (line 15, perhaps 'wet') could not be read as words; '-ammon' (line 14) may be 'sand'. 'Give way' (line 13, χαλάσῃ) is uncertain in sense. In line 18 the scribe wrote ζῆλος ('jealousy') and deleted it beside δῆλος ('exposed'); μεμωλυσμένον is taken as 'defiled'. οὐάτι[ον] (line 19) is taken as 'little ear'.
